events.title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip released
events.summary: Samsung began selling the Samsung Galaxy Z Flip — clamshell foldable with a small outer display — new form factor for Android.
events.about: Foldables forced Android developers to handle resizable and multi-window layouts on flexible displays. Clamshell foldable with a small outer display — new form factor for android.

narrative.whyChosen: The Samsung Galaxy Z Flip pushed foldable Android hardware into the mainstream.
narrative.whyImportant: Foldable form factors require adaptive [UI] patterns beyond fixed phone screens.
narrative.problemSolved: Phones were locked to a single rigid screen size and aspect ratio.

events.title: Elon Musk: "OpenAI should be more open"
events.quoteText: OpenAI should be more open imo
events.summary: Years after leaving OpenAI's board, Elon Musk tweets that the research lab he co-founded is not living up to its name.
events.about: Musk helped launch OpenAI as a nonprofit counterweight to Google, then clashed over direction and funding. The tweet foreshadowed his later attacks on OpenAI's Microsoft partnership and his founding of xAI.

narrative.whyChosen: The moment a co-founder publicly broke with OpenAI's openness mission.
narrative.whyImportant: It framed later debates about closed frontier models and corporate control.
narrative.problemSolved: Observers needed language for the gap between OpenAI's brand and its practices.
